partner_result_applied.scope: Delocalized active-spectral-space Fresnel--Brascamp--Lieb density theorem; universal when active geometric mean is at least one, with unresolved spectral-truncation debt.

other_result_applied.scope: Zero-diagonal-pair 3x3 block theorem with arbitrary outside couplings; used for the all-zero-diagonal nonsingular local triple.

new_results.statement: For a nonsingular binary quadratic residual with Delta=beta*delta-gamma^2 and independent densities <=1, P(|R-t|<r)<=8r/s+s^2/|Delta| for all s>0, hence <=min(1,3*2^(4/3) r^(2/3)|Delta|^(-1/3)).

If an original-coordinate nonsingular 3x3 principal block B has nonzero diagonal pivot a, then the full arbitrary-dimensional quadratic form, with arbitrary outside couplings, has density norm <=8*3^(3/4)|a det B|^(-1/4).
Combining the scalar-pivot theorem with account03/B01, every fixed nonsingular original-coordinate principal 3x3 block admits a finite arbitrary-law density bound with arbitrary outside couplings.

mechanism_counterexample: In the rank-three Walsh projector used by the named partner, A_ii=3/n and every 3x3 principal determinant is <=(3/n)^3, so |A_ii det A_I|<=81/n^4; selecting one local triple cannot yield a dimension-free full proof although the partner global theorem handles the family.
